items.title: Myles Garrett: Needs knee scope, headed for IR
items.description:
Garrett is scheduled to undergo arthroscopic surgery on his left knee in the coming days and is expected to be placed on injured reserve, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Time on exempt list could equal time served
items.description:
Jacobs (personal) remains on the Commissioner's Exempt List, but the NFL may count time on the list as time served if it eventually issues a suspension to the running back, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
